## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run audit:prod`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant customer and admin flows checked manually

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated uploads, or local environment files are included
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, validation, rate limits, and logs were considered where relevant
- [ ] New dependencies and external services are justified and documented
- [ ] Database or environment-variable changes include migration and rollback notes
